team_model: Owner working with Codex; no separate developer team
owner_target: Approximately one and a half months
target_interpretation: Full scoped application release candidate by week 6; production switch depends on migration/pilot/performance gates; stabilization and retirement are separate accepted steps. Stretch timeboxes, not measured duration forecasts.
scope_policy: No silent L1/parity deferrals; preserve all feature IDs and conditional scope decisions.
